description_zh: 晴天下午，一辆直行面包车（ego）在路口遇到对向车辆（v2）左转，发生侧面碰撞。无量化细节，环境与控制信号按报告推导。

source_snippets: The Waymo AV, while in autonomous mode, was waiting to make a left turn and yielding to oncoming traffic, when the test driver ... proceeded with a left turn manually. During the left turn, an approaching van struck the right side of the Waymo AV.
evidence.reason: ego 选为直行的面包车，测试其对向车左转的避让能力；NPC 动作为路口转弯冲突（junction_turn），可行表达该双方交互碰撞。
